p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=max(map(len,grid)); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Locate the distinctive L-shaped guide: a vertical run plus a horizontal
    # run meeting at one endpoint.
    guides=[]
    for color in counts:
        if color==bg: continue
        cells={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color}
        for c in range(w):
            rs=[r for r in range(h) if (r,c) in cells]
            if len(rs)<5: continue
            for elbow in (min(rs),max(rs)):
                arm=[x for x in range(w) if (elbow,x) in cells]
                if len(arm)>=4:
                    guides.append((len(rs)+len(arm),color,c,elbow,min(rs),max(rs),min(arm),max(arm)))
    if not guides: return out
    _,mark,col,er,rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=max(guides)
    # The target object lies in the open quadrant opposite the two arms.
    vertical_arm=-1 if er==rmax else 1  # stem direction from elbow
    horizontal_arm=1 if cmax>col else -1
    qr=-vertical_arm; qc=-horizontal_arm
    seen=set(); candidates=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v in (bg,mark) or (r,c) in seen: continue
            comp=[]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<len(grid[ny]) and grid[ny][nx]==v and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            cy=sum(y for y,x in comp)/len(comp); cx=sum(x for y,x in comp)/len(comp)
            if (cy-er)*qr>0 and (cx-col)*qc>0:
                candidates.append((len(comp),comp))
    if candidates:
        # The uniquely prominent object in the guide's open quadrant is the target.
        comp=max(candidates,key=lambda item:item[0])[1]
        for r,c in comp: out[r][c]=mark
    return out
''')

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-2f7d0ec0.py')
p.write_text('''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Discover the marker color as a long L: vertical stem, horizontal foot.
    freq=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row); bg=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    candidates=[]
    for color in freq:
        if color==bg: continue
        cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color}
        for c in range(w):
            rs=[r for r in range(h) if (r,c) in cells]
            if len(rs)<5: continue
            for elbow in (min(rs),max(rs)):
                armlen=sum((elbow,x) in cells for x in range(w))
                if armlen>=4:
                    candidates.append((len(rs)+armlen,color,c,elbow,min(rs),max(rs)))
    if not candidates: return out
    _,mark,col,elbow,rlo,rhi=max(candidates)
    # Recolor the closest connected object (other than background and marker)
    # directly across the corner into the quadrant opposite the L's arms.
    stem=-1 if elbow==rhi else 1
    arm=1 if sum(grid[elbow][x]==mark for x in range(col+1,w)) >= sum(grid[elbow][x]==mark for x in range(col)) else -1
    target_r=-stem; target_c=-arm
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if v in (bg,mark) or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==v:
              seen.add((ny,nx));q.append((ny,nx))
        cy=sum(y for y,x in comp)/len(comp); cx=sum(x for y,x in comp)/len(comp)
        if (cy-elbow)*target_r>0 and (cx-col)*target_c>0:
          d=(cy-elbow)**2+(cx-col)**2
          comps.append((d,comp))
    if comps:
      for r,c in min(comps,key=lambda z:z[0])[1]: out[r][c]=mark
    return out
''')

p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=max(map(len,grid)); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    freq=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    guides=[]
    for color in freq:
        if color==bg: continue
        cells={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color}
        for c in range(w):
            rs=[r for r in range(h) if (r,c) in cells]
            if len(rs)<5: continue
            for elbow in (min(rs),max(rs)):
                arm=[x for x in range(w) if (elbow,x) in cells]
                if len(arm)>=4:
                    guides.append((len(rs)+len(arm),color,c,elbow,min(rs),max(rs),min(arm),max(arm)))
    if not guides: return out
    _,mark,col,elbow,rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax=max(guides)
    # Target lies in the quadrant opposite the marker's vertical and horizontal arms.
    open_r=1 if elbow==rmin else -1
    open_c=-1 if cmax>col else 1
    seen=set(); candidates=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v in (bg,mark) or (r,c) in seen: continue
            comp=[]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<len(grid[ny]) and grid[ny][nx]==v and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            cy=sum(y for y,x in comp)/len(comp); cx=sum(x for y,x in comp)/len(comp)
            if (cy-elbow)*open_r>0 and (cx-col)*open_c>0:
                candidates.append(comp)
    if candidates:
        target=max(candidates,key=len)

    return out
''')
